subject.title: Bug: License incorrectly displayed as MIT-0 instead of MIT

question: Should ClawHub keep the fixed MIT-0 platform license model, or change to honoring declared upstream MIT skill licenses for new and existing published skills?
rationale: Current main intentionally encodes fixed MIT-0 licensing, while the reporter and open candidate PR ask ClawHub to represent upstream MIT package metadata; that is a license-policy and migration decision automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Approve declared-license support
options.body: Land the mixed MIT/MIT-0 model only after real behavior proof and an operator-safe backfill plan for existing versions.

options.title: Reaffirm fixed MIT-0
options.body: Keep current platform licensing, close the issue and candidate PR with clear publisher-facing guidance, and avoid display-only MIT changes.

options.title: Split future and existing behavior
options.body: Support declared licenses for future publishes first while tracking existing-version repair as a separate migration/backfill decision.

recommendation.title: Approve declared-license support
recommendation.body: Land the mixed MIT/MIT-0 model only after real behavior proof and an operator-safe backfill plan for existing versions.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the MIT-0 enforcement commit and gave the prior product-direction comment on the closed license metadata PR.
